nodes.label: Pre-existing Build/Env Constraint (NEXTAUTH_URL empty)
nodes.rationale: npm run build fails pre-existing: empty NEXTAUTH_URL -> /portal-login prerender TypeError: Invalid URL; dev cannot render any route (localStorage.getItem is not a function + local PostgreSQL down). User ruling 2026-08-13: keep .env as-is, never touch env or build env code; gate with tsc + eslint + scoped visual inspection instead of npm run build.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Design System Foundation
nodes.rationale: Shipped commits 1b7c53a..31c63d2; review clean. Deferrals by design: motion tokens -> Phase 1; deriveAnnouncementStatus -> Phase 2; sortable ledger -> Phase 3. Phase 0 defaults to night to avoid full-app flip; html.theme-light built but untoggled. Next: Phase 1 shell plan from spec.

nodes.label: Typography System (Sora + JetBrains Mono)
nodes.rationale: Spec 3.2: Sora 600/700 display voice; JetBrains Mono 400/500/600 for numerals/IDs/clocks/counts/timestamps; Inter stays body; Montserrat heading fallback; --font-sora/--font-mono CSS variables fed to Tailwind.

nodes.label: Semantic Token System (night/paper)
nodes.rationale: Night on :root because body already uses bg-dark-primary (zero visual change at phase end); html.theme-light (paper) is an opt-in capability toggled in later phases. Legacy names --brand-red/--bg-*/--text-*/--border-color/--color-* kept as aliases so existing inline-style components keep working; --color-error restored (commit b86aac9). Status colors get -subtle variants; --accent: var(--site-primary, var(--brand-red)).

nodes.label: Tailwind Token Mapping
nodes.rationale: Maps CSS variables to utilities bg-surface-0..3, text-text-1..3, border-border, accent(+subtle), success/warning/danger/info(+subtle), radius control/card/sheet/accent, shadow lvl-1..3, fonts display/mono, fade-in/slide-up/scaleIn keyframes. border gets DEFAULT key; benign borderWidth namespace overlap warning expected.

nodes.label: ui/ Kit (Button, Card, Badge, StatusPill, Input, Select, Table, Dropdown)
nodes.rationale: Primitive API contracts consumed by Phases 1-4; Button variants/sizes, Table sortable via onSort, Dropdown stateful; 'use client' only where state lives. Fix round 135624c added Dropdown accent focus ring; 2 brief TS errors corrected by implementer.

nodes.label: StatusPill (Announcement Status Pill)
nodes.rationale: Presentational only: maps draft/scheduled/published/taken-down/pending-approval to Badge tone + Phosphor icon + Indonesian label; derivation (deriveAnnouncementStatus) lands Phase 2 so the pill stays honest from day 1.

nodes.label: AdminSiteThemeProvider (--site-primary driver)
nodes.rationale: Server component feeding existing SiteThemeProvider from resolveAdminSiteId() + prisma.site.findUnique({name,slug,primaryColor}); --accent: var(--site-primary, var(--brand-red)) in BOTH :root and html.theme-light (coordinator-added); fallback #ED1C24; not yet wrapped in any layout.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Verification Gates
nodes.rationale: npx tsc --noEmit + npm run lint + token audit (verify-tokens.mjs 7/7 PASS: night+paper surfaces/text/border per spec 3.1; accent resolves #ED1C24 fallback; --color-error present). npm run build skipped with documented env reason.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Admin Shell
nodes.rationale: Commits 98a0982..e2a6748: lib/admin-nav.ts; AdminSiteThemeProvider wired in layout; token-native grouped collapsible sidebar (localStorage adminSidebarCollapsed); AdminTopbar (breadcrumb, channel strip, mono live clock, Dropdown user menu); Ctrl+K CommandPalette; MastheadRack replaces SiteSelector (deleted file). Motion-token pass + theme toggle deferred to Phase 2.

nodes.label: Shared Admin Nav Model (lib/admin-nav.ts)
nodes.rationale: AdminNavItem + AdminNavGroup + adminNavGroups is the single nav truth consumed by sidebar (T2) and palette (T4); active-item exact-match helper; superAdminOnly applied at group level (Saluran group). Plan missed superAdminOnly interface field - implementer added it (TS errors).

nodes.rationale: Global Ctrl/Cmd+K, backdrop-blur overlay, query filters fixed actions + all admin nav items, ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape, content row placeholder ('Cari di daftar pengumuman...'), real content search deferred to Phase 2; entries anchored to adminNavGroups.

nodes.rationale: Chip selection is PURE client state (useState) - no fetch, no URL change, no server queries; group names come from server groups, NOT PortalApp.category; grid grid-cols-1 sm:2 lg:3 xl:4 (375px safe); filtered-empty defensive branch implements locked group copy contract; section authors from original component.

Atur visibility lewat Pengaturan.' + CTA 'Buka Pengaturan'); group variant 'Belum ada aplikasi di grup ini.' defensive today but implements locked group-scoped copy contract; font-medium banned - weights locked 400/600; no half-step spacing.

nodes.rationale: Wave 2, 11 files, 3 commits (31500e5 / 1055948 / 903dbe5), zero new capabilities: centered-sheet failure/denied family + account selector, interstitials + vault (forms byte-identical), wizard/settings/credentials; SSO launch behavior and API contracts frozen; type/weight discipline: text sizes 12/14/20/24, weights 400/600 only, icon sizes 12/16/20/24; no half-step spacing; named top-level Phosphor imports only.

nodes.rationale: Token sheets with 56px logo sheet, animate-spin spinner (replaces inline style keyframes), mono injection rows, masked password; frozen: 1.5s timer + hidden form fields (method/action/type=hidden) byte-identical (counts 5/4); only style={{display:'none'}} -> className='hidden'.

nodes.rationale: Mono rows with password mask, h-[42px] ghost icon buttons (aria-labels), copied flash Check 16; window.open noopener,noreferrer + copyText clipboard/execCommand fallback byte-identical; no delete action added.

nodes.label: OnboardingWizard + pass-through settings (visibility)
nodes.rationale: Single-screen wizard (assumption UI-SPEC 7.3 applied - no invented step nav) with kit Cards + accent checkboxes; frozen submit(skip) body (groupIdsOff/appIdsOff/appIdsOn/skip) + fetch /api/portal/visibility + window.location.href=/portal; VisibilitySettings renders wizard in settings mode byte-identical.

nodes.label: Portal Credentials Page (accordion + form)
nodes.rationale: Kit accordion cards, initial tiles 36px, health line mono digit (dropped legacy unicode check/warning glyphs), danger ghost delete via kit ConfirmDialog, add form via kit Input/Button (Plus 16), empty tile with Key 24; GET/POST/DELETE?credentialId= byte-identical; password rows NEVER pre-filled (form state initializes empty per app) - PORT-08.

nodes.label: Portal Admin Ledgers Restyle (11-04)
nodes.rationale: 5 admin portal pages (sessions/audit/users/apps/groups) token-native: Table kit sortable (aria-sort), Badge, modals, pagination, CSV export audit + 'Deteksi Otomatis' diagnosis, fetch-failure separated from empty ledger; contract API 0 diff vs base 903dbe5; 14 no-explicit-any warnings; stat tiles keep original semantics; icon renames (Pulse/UserCircle).

nodes.label: Manual E2E Checklist (9 steps incl lockout)
nodes.rationale: Checklist .planning/.../11-E2E-CHECKLIST.md: 9-step manual (login -> grid -> save credential -> SSO -> picker -> fail -> lockout message 'Akun terkunci' -> revoke -> audit trail) + automation evidences OPD-1/OPD-4/scope legend via git diff; fix commit 5c14cb6 (half-step fixes, error vs empty audit ledger).

nodes.label: Phase 2 Content Desk Plan
nodes.rationale: Written but not yet executed: honest announcement status from isPublished/scheduledAt/takedownAt; masthead-aware dashboard tiles; StatusPill-driven ledger with filters/bulk dialog; two-pane composer with live preview + word count; absorbs deferred Phase 1 items (motion tokens, theme toggle, palette content/site search, rack live+scheduled counts).

nodes.label: deriveAnnouncementStatus (truthful status derivation)
nodes.rationale: New helper deriving draft/scheduled/published/taken-down from isPublished + scheduledAt + takedownAt - no schema change; ApprovalRequest model DROPPED by migration 20260605010000_drop_approval_add_revision; StatusPill pending-approval stays in union but is never emitted; getSiteLiveScheduledCounts already uses it.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Data Surfaces Plan
nodes.rationale: Spec 6: chart language (recharts theme-native, primary series follows masthead via useSiteTheme --site-primary, others neutral + one contrast); StatTile KPI tiles (mono numeral + optional delta, 16px icon, headline reading, sparse); ledger tables Sites/Users on sortable Table kit (aria-sort, mono numerals, filter/pagination); audit timeline ledger (quantum timestamp, actor, action, entity, outcome) with filters + export preserved; global analytics per-site masthead comparison; behavior-preservation boundary (no route/schema/auth/scheduler redesign).

nodes.label: Masthead-Aware Chart Theme (getChartTheme)
nodes.rationale: getChartTheme() + ChartTooltip recharts content; primary series follows the ACTIVE masthead via --site-primary; themes for normal/danger/neutral; delta omitted - no previous-period source in /api/analytics; empty/loading states required.

nodes.label: StatTile KPI Tile
nodes.rationale: Big mono number + optional delta, 16px Phosphor icon, headline reading; tokens only (no 4 hardcoded colors - the legacy #dc2626/#22c55e/#ba8308/#3b82f6 palette dropped).

nodes.label: Sortable Ledger Tables (Sites/Users/Audit)
nodes.rationale: Table kit already sortable (sortKey + aria-sort); Sites desk stays CARDS grid (health metrics from /api/sites/{id}/health would be lost in dense table - deliberate); Users desk becomes ledger + role badges + token modal; audit trail becomes timeline ledger with filter/export/pagination preserved.

nodes.label: CMS Architecture Ground Rules (NextJS 15 + Prisma + TipTap)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19, PostgreSQL via Prisma 5, NextAuth (JWT credentials), Tailwind CSS, TipTap rich-text editor. UI strings and commit messages are in Indonesian. Prisma client imported via singleton lib/prisma.ts (guards hot-reload connection exhaustion); @/* path alias maps to repo root (tsconfig.json). Required env: DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, CRON_SECRET, ENABLE_AUTO_UPDATE, PORTAL_CREDENTIAL_KEY.

nodes.label: Multi-Site Core Domain Model
nodes.rationale: Announcement<->Site many-to-many via AnnouncementSite junction (isPrimary); never assume single site - query via sites.some({siteId}), derive primarySite from junction; Category/NewsletterSubscriber/SiteSettings hard-scoped to siteId; MediaLibrary/ActivityLog/EmailTemplate nullable siteId.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Access Control
nodes.rationale: isSuperAdmin bypasses all checks; per-site UserSiteAccess SiteRole (SITE_ADMIN>EDITOR>VIEWER) separate from User.role; ALWAYS gate writes via lib/site-access.ts (canEditOnSite/canAdminSite/getAccessibleSites); API routes target siteIds via junction; auth options: same session cookie, callbackUrl scoped.

nodes.label: Portal SSO Layer
nodes.rationale: Separate from CMS: PortalUser vs admin User; NextAuth instance via lib/portal-auth.ts prefix portal-auth.*; AES-256-GCM credential encryption (PORTAL_CREDENTIAL_KEY fail-closed); RBAC via lib/portal-access.ts; SSO form-based credential forwarding auto-submitting POST to app loginUrl; audits all transactions; admin pages under /admin/portal-*.

nodes.label: Audit Trail (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: AuditLog (audit_logs) is the single source of truth for ALL transactions across admin CMS, portal users, and system. Write only via logAudit() from lib/audit.ts - non-blocking, never throws (don't gate main transaction), auto-redacts sensitive keys (password, token, credentialBlob, secret) from changes/metadata. Cleanup by scheduler purge honoring AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS (default 365, 0 = forever). Admin page: /admin/audit-trail (SuperAdmin only) with export.

nodes.label: Site Context Propagation (httpOnly cookies)
nodes.rationale: current_site_id/current_site_slug httpOnly cookies in lib/site-context.ts; manual POST /api/context + reload; public routes path-based /site/[slug]/; legacy 301 redirects; root / -> site picker in middleware.

nodes.label: Request Pipeline & API Route Conventions
nodes.rationale: middleware.ts: root redirect, security headers, in-memory IP rate limiting (stricter on /auth,/backup; non-distributed); API: getServerSession(authOptions), Zod schema validation, DOMPurify sanitize of all HTML user content; ActivityLog for legacy ops; forbidden patterns: <style>, dangerous innerHTML, no raw SQL (except migration), no tuple types in API response schemas.

nodes.label: JWT Auth with DB-Backed Session Revocation
nodes.rationale: NextAuth JWT strategy; every token refresh re-checks UserSession.isRevoked/expiresAt and clears the token if revoked (fail-open on DB error); sign-in creates UserSession row; portal-auth is a separate instance with own prefix.

nodes.label: Throttled Scheduler (auto-publish/takedown)
nodes.rationale: No external cron: runScheduler() throttled (60s) and invoked opportunistically from server render (app/admin/page.tsx); (1) auto-publishes (scheduledAt <= now), (2) auto-takes-down (takedownAt <= now), (3) purges stale AuditLog rows per AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS. Also a protected /api/scheduler route (Bearer CRON_SECRET) for external triggering.

nodes.label: Domain Docs Consumption (CONTEXT/ADRs)
nodes.rationale: Docs consumption: read CONTEXT.md (single-context) or CONTEXT-MAP.md (multi-context) + ADRs in docs/adr/ and src/<context>/docs/adr/ BEFORE exploring; use the glossary vocabulary without drift; surface ADR conflicts explicitly (never silently prefer one); domain-modeling skill creates docs lazily - don't create files upfront.

nodes.label: GitHub Issue Tracker (gh CLI + wayfinder map)
nodes.rationale: Issues and specs live in GitHub Issues (gh CLI), repo torpedoliar/Anouncement-Dashboard-Local. gh issue create/list/comment/edit --add-label/close; PRs as triage surface NO; same number space, resolve with gh pr view. wayfinder: single map issue labeled wayfinder:map + child tickets (bug/feat/chore/gnic) with types, blocked-legacy via native GitHub dependency edges, frontier query, claim sequence, resolve = answer comment + close. Labels: needs-triage/needs-info/ready-for-agent/ready-for-human/wontfix. See docs/agents/issue-tracker.md.
